grammar.pattern: above / below · inside / outside · front / back · left / right · east / south / west / north
grammar.purpose: Locate an object using a clear reference
grammar.explanation: The twelve direction words are 上、下、里、外、前、后、左、右、东、南、西、北. Their side forms are 上边、下边、里边、外边、前边、后边、左边、右边、东边、南边、西边、北边. Say what they are relative to: 楼的东边, 门外. Left/right depend on the person’s orientation; east/west do not. This unit’s map explicitly puts north at the top; do not assume every map does.

examples.py: mén lǐ , mén wài , lóu shàng , lóu xià .
examples.en: Inside and outside the gate; upstairs and downstairs.

examples.zh: 楼前、楼后，门左边、门右边。
examples.py: lóu qián , lóu hòu , mén zuǒ biān , mén yòu biān .
examples.en: In front of and behind the building; to the left and right of the gate.

examples.zh: 上边、下边、里边、外边、前边、后边。
examples.py: shàng biān , xià biān , lǐ bian , wài biān , qián biān , hòu biān .
examples.en: Above, below, inside, outside, in front, behind.

examples.zh: 左边、右边、东边、南边、西边、北边。
examples.py: zuǒ biān , yòu biān , dōng biān , nán biān , xī biān , běi biān .
examples.en: Left, right, east, south, west, north.

examples.zh: 面向北，右边是东，左边是西。
examples.py: miàn xiàng běi , yòu biān shì dōng , zuǒ biān shì xī .
examples.en: Facing north, east is on the right and west on the left.

commonMistakes.why: Right is east only in this stated orientation.

grammar.purpose: Understand an utterance without an expressed subject and predicate
grammar.explanation: A context can support a short non-subject-predicate utterance: 在北门外 answers 在哪儿？; 两个人 answers 几个人？; 好！ accepts a suggestion. Signs can simply say 入口 or 出口. These are complete communicative utterances in context, not a reason to omit necessary information in every sentence. Use a full statement if the reference could be ambiguous.

examples.py: zài nǎr ? zài běi mén wài .
jǐ gè rén ? liǎng gè rén .

commonMistakes.why: A location question needs a place, not a number.

dialogue.title: Which entrance?
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the meeting gate and the orientation used for directions.

lines.zh: 我到学校南边了，你们在哪儿？
lines.py: wǒ dào xué xiào nán biān le , nǐ men zài nǎr ?
lines.en: I have reached the south side of the school. Where are you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在北门外。北边有车站，南边有商店。
lines.py: zài běi mén wài . běi biān yǒu chē zhàn , nán biān yǒu shāng diàn .
lines.en: Outside the north gate. There is a station to the north and a shop to the south.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我看地图，上边是北，下边是南，对吗？
lines.py: wǒ kàn dì tú , shàng biān shì běi , xià biān shì nán , duì ma ?
lines.en: On the map, the top is north and the bottom is south, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，这张地图上边有一个北字。东在右，西在左。
lines.py: duì , zhè zhāng dì tú shàng biān yǒu yī gè běi zì . dōng zài yòu , xī zài zuǒ .
lines.en: Yes, this map has a north character at the top. East is right, west is left.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 楼的东边有两个入口，我走哪个？
lines.py: lóu de dōng biān yǒu liǎng gè rù kǒu , wǒ zǒu nǎ gè ?
lines.en: There are two entrances on the east side of the building. Which do I take?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先到北门。我们不在东边的入口，也不在西边的书店。
lines.py: xiān dào běi mén . wǒ men bù zài dōng biān de rù kǒu , yě bù zài xī biān de shū diàn .
lines.en: Come to the north gate first. We are not at the eastern entrance or the western bookshop.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我现在面向北，左边是西，右边是东。
lines.py: wǒ xiàn zài miàn xiàng běi , zuǒ biān shì xī , yòu biān shì dōng .
lines.en: I am facing north now: west is on the left, east on the right.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。前边是北，后边是南。你先看前，再看后。
lines.py: duì . qián biān shì běi , hòu biān shì nán . nǐ xiān kàn qián , zài kàn hòu .
lines.en: Correct. Ahead is north, behind is south. Look ahead first, then behind.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 北门前边有两个人，是你们吗？
lines.py: běi mén qián biān yǒu liǎng gè rén , shì nǐ men ma ?
lines.en: There are two people in front of the north gate. Is that you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是，我们在门前等你。停车场在楼后边。
lines.py: shì , wǒ men zài mén qián děng nǐ . tíng chē chǎng zài lóu hòu biān .
lines.en: Yes, we are waiting in front of the gate. The car park is behind the building.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我在两个入口中间，现在看到你们了。
lines.py: wǒ zài liǎng gè rù kǒu zhōng jiān , xiàn zài kàn dào nǐ men le .
lines.en: I am between the two entrances. I can see you now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好！看箭头，入口指左，出口指右。我们从入口进去。
lines.py: hǎo ! kàn jiàn tóu , rù kǒu zhǐ zuǒ , chū kǒu zhǐ yòu . wǒ men cóng rù kǒu jìn qù .
lines.en: Good! Look at the arrows: entrance points left, exit points right. We will go in through the entrance.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Which orientation makes right equal east?
Does the friend need the east-side entrance to meet the group?
choices: No, the group says to reach the north gate first
Yes, the group waits at that entrance
They do not name a meeting gate
questions.answer: No, the group says to reach the north gate first

reading.title: Directions in a message
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Find the meeting location before following the entry sign.

lines.zh: 今天我们在学校北门外等朋友。
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ men zài xué xiào běi mén wài děng péng you .
lines.en: Today we are waiting for a friend outside the school’s north gate.

lines.zh: 学校北边是车站，南边有商店，西边有书店。
lines.py: xué xiào běi biān shì chē zhàn , nán biān yǒu shāng diàn , xī biān yǒu shū diàn .
lines.en: There is a station north of the school, a shop to the south and a bookshop to the west.

lines.zh: 楼的东边有两个入口，但我们在北门前。
lines.py: lóu de dōng biān yǒu liǎng gè rù kǒu , dàn wǒ men zài běi mén qián .
lines.en: There are two entrances on the east side of the building, but we are in front of the north gate.

lines.zh: 这张地图上边是北，下边是南；右是东，左是西。
lines.py: zhè zhāng dì tú shàng biān shì běi , xià biān shì nán ; yòu shì dōng , zuǒ shì xī .
lines.en: On this map, north is at the top and south at the bottom; east is right, west is left.

lines.zh: 面向北的时候，前边是北，后边是南。
lines.py: miàn xiàng běi de shí hou , qián biān shì běi , hòu biān shì nán .
lines.en: When facing north, north is ahead and south is behind.

lines.zh: 停车场在楼后边，门前有两个人。
lines.py: tíng chē chǎng zài lóu hòu biān , mén qián yǒu liǎng gè rén .
lines.en: The car park is behind the building; there are two people in front of the gate.

lines.zh: 朋友先在两个入口中间，后来看到我们。
lines.py: péng you xiān zài liǎng gè rù kǒu zhōng jiān , hòu lái kàn dào wǒ men .
lines.en: Our friend was between the two entrances first, then saw us.

lines.zh: 我们一起看箭头：入口在左，出口在右。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ kàn jiàn tóu : rù kǒu zài zuǒ , chū kǒu zài yòu .
lines.en: We look at the arrows together: entrance on the left, exit on the right.

choices: Finding the meeting point and entrance
questions.answer: Finding the meeting point and entrance

questions.q: What is north of the school?

choices: To make front/back and left/right unambiguous
To say every map faces north
questions.answer: To make front/back and left/right unambiguous

lines.py: yǒu , kě shì wǒ men zài mén qián , bù zài nà biān . xī biān shì shū diàn .

lines.py: duì . lóu hòu biān shì tíng chē chǎng . lái běi mén qián biān ba .

lines.py: kàn dào le ! rù kǒu zhǐ zuǒ , chū kǒu zhǐ yòu . hǎo !
lines.en: I see you! Entrance points left, exit right. Okay!
